title: Dermatologist Perceptions of Biologic Therapies in Moderate-to-Severe Plaque Psoriasis
intro: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your primary professional role?
How many years have you been in clinical practice?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

questions.text: Which of the following biologic treatments for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis are you aware of?
What is your most important treatment goal when selecting a biologic for plaque psoriasis?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: Present options in the exact order listed above. Do not randomize.

questions.text: Which biologic do you prescribe most often for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: The brand selected in Q3 must be piped into the text of Q4.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with [PIPE: Q3 selection] for your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients?

piping.note: Replace [PIPE: Q3 selection] with the brand chosen in Q3.

questions.text: Please rate your agreement with each of the following statements.
rows: Biologics have transformed outcomes in plaque psoriasis
Access barriers limit my use of newer biologics
I am comfortable initiating biologics in biologic-naive patients

questions.text: What percentage of your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients currently receive a biologic?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

questions.text: In your view, what is the single biggest barrier to your patients' access to biologic therapy?
How likely are you to recommend biologic therapy to a colleague treating moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?
questions.instruction: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
